uti.title: Urinary infection
uti.label: Urinary infection symptoms
uti.warning: If you have a fever, chills or pain in your side, see a doctor soon.

suitability: Suited to after childbirth, menopause and any time you leak urine. If you have pelvic pain or heaviness, talk to a doctor or pelvic physiotherapist first.
